title: April 2026 Manibigama Kiln Opening
how_to_join: Attend at ESAC Fairhope Pinehill KilnYard
source_quote:
April 2026 Manibigama Kiln Opening
ESAC Fairhope Pinehill KilnYard
Fresh, Hot Woodfired Pottery
Weds. Apr. 8, 2026
10:00 AM -2:PM
Free
summary: Join the public unloading of the ESAC Manabigama wood-fired kiln on April 8, 2026. Participants aid in removing warm pots in a relay chain and help examine each piece.
evidence_sentence: The page describes the April 2026 Manibigama Kiln Opening as the culmination of firing and loading the ESAC Manibigama wood-fired kiln.
evidence_quote: This Opening is the culmination of firing and loading the ESAC Manibigama wood-fired kiln on the previous weekend.
